An '''improved sensor package''' was an upgraded set of [[Photoreceptor/Legends|visual]] and [[Audio sensor/Legends|auditory]] sensors that could be installed on a [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="RCR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
